main.description: One round of shelfguessr, recorded by the guesser after they picked an answer. `actual` is the real owner of the shelf photo shown; `guessed` is who the player clicked; `correct` is guessed === actual, denormalized for cheap replay. The network-wide /leaderboard standings are computed client-side by replaying every player's such records (listReposByCollection + Jetstream) into a correct/total tally — same recipe as sites/skymash's vote -> elo.js, just a plain count instead of Elo. Written and read by shelfguessr (https://shelfguessr.bisks.net).

actual.description: DID of the shelf's real owner.

guessed.description: DID the player clicked as their guess.

correct.description: Whether guessed === actual, denormalized so the leaderboard replay doesn't need to compare strings.

clusterSeed.description: DID of the handle whose SimCluster this round was drawn from (self + mutuals) — not necessarily the player's own DID, since anyone can spectate any cluster.

guessedAt.description: When this guess was made, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
